cc:Work.dc:title: Bonsai with Flower
cc:Work.dc:description: A lot of English speakers pronounce this like 'ban-zai' but that's wrong. It's 'bon' (like in 'bon voyage') and 'sai' (said like the English word 'sigh') but you can say it anyway you want. It's just a little tree in a pot after all. They are super cool though, right?
